newsitem.title: CHINA: Shandong Cable plans B share IPO in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Shandong Cable plans B share IPO in 1998.

text.p: China's Shandong Electric Cable and Appliance Co Ltd plans to make an initial public offering of hard currency B shares for listing in Shenzhen in 1998, company spokesman Chu Jun said on Wednesday.

The firm has ruled out the B share offer in 1997 because it had sufficient funds following an offer of 40 million domestic A shares to raise 264 million yuan last April, Chu told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The company, based in Tai'an city in the eastern province of Shandong, is among 33 domestic enterprises approved in early 1997 by Beijing to list B shares.
The company has said it would use the A share proceeds to boost production of electric and telecommunication cables.
It announced net profits of 56.13 million yuan for the first half of 1997, against 32.23 million in the year-ago period based on Chinese accounting standards.
Chu said the earnings surge was fuelled by solid demand for its cable products, benefiting from the rapid development of China's electric power industry this year. He declined to comment further.
Sales reached 245.69 million yuan in the first half, compared with 220.74 million yuan, Shandong Cable said in an interim report carried in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
